violations.description: Secret-bearing credentials file present in git history
violations.evidence: config/credentials.json was committed and subsequently deleted in commit 45b2b4e
violations.recommendation: Rewrite git history or rotate credentials exposed in historical commits.

violations.description: Secret-bearing .env file committed to repository
violations.evidence: .env contains database credentials and secret key.
violations.recommendation: Remove .env from git tracking, add to .gitignore, and rotate exposed credentials.

violations.description: Dangerous pull_request_target checkout of untrusted PR code
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/deploy.yml uses pull_request_target with ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
violations.recommendation: Use standard pull_request trigger or avoid checking out and executing untrusted PR head commit with write permissions.

violations.description: Secret printed to CI logs
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/deploy.yml echoes registry token in plain text: echo "Using token ${{ secrets.REGISTRY_TOKEN }}"
violations.recommendation: Remove logging of secrets.

violations.description: Hardcoded AWS access key and database password in config.py
violations.evidence: app/config.py has AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and DB_PASSWORD hardcoded.
violations.recommendation: Move credentials to environment variables read via os.environ.

violations.description: Risky deploy automation without test gate and triggering on push
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/deploy.yml triggers on any push and deploy jobs lack test validation gates
violations.recommendation: Ensure tests pass successfully in CI before allowing deployment.

violations.description: Incorrect CI branch filter excludes default branch
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml triggers on push to master, but default branch is main
violations.recommendation: Update branch trigger to main.

violations.description: Ineffective quality gate masking test failures
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs pytest with || true
violations.recommendation: Remove || true so test failures fail the CI pipeline.

violations.description: Over-privileged workflow token permissions (write-all)
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml specifies permissions: write-all
violations.recommendation: Restrict permissions to the minimum necessary scopes.

violations.description: Script injection via untrusted github.event data interpolated into workflow run step
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml interpolates ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} directly into bash run block
violations.recommendation: Use an environment variable to pass event data safely into shell scripts.

violations.description: SSL certificate verification disabled in requests call
violations.evidence: app/storage.py sets verify=False in requests.get
violations.recommendation: Enable SSL certificate verification (verify=True or provide CA bundle).

violations.description: Insecure settings including debug mode in production and curl piped to bash
violations.evidence: app/config.py sets DEBUG = True in production; scripts/deploy.sh executes curl ... | bash
violations.recommendation: Disable debug mode in production and avoid piping remote scripts directly to bash.

violations.description: Tests are broken and cannot pass due to importing a missing module
violations.evidence: tests/test_storage.py imports from app.legacy_cache which does not exist in the repository
violations.recommendation: Remove the missing import and obsolete test or implement the missing module.

violations.description: Dockerfile uses unpinned latest base image and lacks .dockerignore
violations.evidence: Dockerfile uses FROM python:latest and lacks a .dockerignore file
violations.recommendation: Pin base image to a specific version digest or tag and add a .dockerignore file.

violations.description: GitHub Action referenced by mutable branch reference
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml uses codecov/codecov-action@master
violations.recommendation: Pin action to a specific full-length commit SHA or tag.

violations.description: Obvious maintainability problem: bare except clause swallowing all exceptions
violations.evidence: app/storage.py uses bare except: pass at line 30
violations.recommendation: Catch specific exceptions (e.g., requests.RequestException) instead of a bare except.

violations.description: Machine-specific absolute path hardcoded in configuration
violations.evidence: app/config.py defines UPLOAD_DIR = C:\Users\ibrahim\...
violations.recommendation: Use relative paths or environment variables for upload directories.

violations.description: Inconsistent dependency specifications across manifest files
violations.evidence: requirements.txt specifies requests>=2.31 while pyproject.toml specifies requests==2.25.1
violations.recommendation: Align dependency version constraints across all requirement/manifest files.

violations.description: Unpinned dependencies in a deployable application manifest
violations.evidence: requirements.txt lists unpinned packages like flask, gunicorn, pytest
violations.recommendation: Pin exact dependency versions or use a lockfile.

violations.description: Generated bytecode, log files, and env files tracked in git
violations.evidence: app/__pycache__/storage.cpython-312.pyc, logs/app.log, and .env are tracked in the repository
violations.recommendation: Remove generated artifacts and secrets from git tracking.

violations.description: Committed IDE personal settings
violations.evidence: .vscode/settings.json is tracked in git
violations.recommendation: Add .vscode/ to .gitignore.

violations.description: .gitignore is incomplete and lacks rules for env files, bytecode, logs, and IDE settings
violations.evidence: .gitignore only ignores *.tmp and node_modules/
violations.recommendation: Add standard ignores for .env, __pycache__, logs/, and .vscode/.
